context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

For Lambda logs, the customer wants only cx_metadata.faas_execution and not the rest of the built-in resource metadata. Are these normal log attributes I should filter with semconv, or Coralogix metadata controls?

checklist.name: resource-log-record
checklist.description: The response matches the pattern: (?i)(resource|log record|metadata)

checklist.name: explains-that-cx-metadata-faas-execution-is-c
checklist.description: Explains that cx_metadata.faas_execution is Coralogix serverless metadata, not a generic OTel log attribute, and that the relevant controls include CX_LOGS_METADATA_ENABLED, CX_LOGS_METADATA_INCLUDE_TRACE_REF, and CX_LOGS_RESOURCE_BUILT_IN_ATTRIBUTES. It must also warn that removing metadata can affect serverless dashboards or trace/log correlation. FAIL if it treats this as a normal semconv rename.
